pl-l2d30c2.summary: Sets the questions: whether the sin of Rom 5:12 is original or actual; if original, what original sin is, why it is called original, and how it has passed or passes to all.
claims: Whether the sin of Romans 5:12 is original or actual must be settled first.
Then it must be asked what original sin is, why it is so called, and how it passes to all.
